verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a payments platform that ships client-side SDKs, checkout components and a local MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking control, or a way to disable one. The MCP tool-subset and API-credential scoping items are access controls, not telemetry opt-outs, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
